scope: A single source-string quote correction for the declared Python >=3.11 support. No algorithms, model specifications, data selections, numerical results, or independent review approvals are changed.

baseline_release_manifest.role: Unchanged historical manifest of the originally published 258-file source release. Its parser hash, inventory hash and independent review hash still describe that original release, not the amended GitHub source bytes.

changed_files.change: Use single-quoted file key inside the double-quoted URL f-string, avoiding Python 3.12-only quote reuse.

full_unittest_discovery.skip_reason: Four tests require intentionally excluded private source caches.

python311_grammar_check.result: All 101 source files pass; the unpatched tennis f-string fails this grammar check. This is not a Python 3.11 runtime test.

verification.python311_runtime: Not available locally; the repository CI workflow executes the complete test suite on Python 3.11 for the amended commit.

equivalence.ast: The complete Python 3.12 AST, including source positions, is identical before and after the quote edit.
equivalence.compiled_code: Serialized Python 3.12 code objects are identical when compiled with the same filename.
equivalence.limit: This verifies executable syntax equivalence, not source-byte identity or a fresh numerical evaluation. The parser reads and hashes its own source, so newly generated parser provenance hashes will intentionally differ.

verification.aggregate_views: All seven existing model views still load in audited_aggregate_snapshot mode under their unchanged implementation and aggregate hash checks.

frozen_evidence.original_archives_and_research_sources: Preserved separately without modification; this amendment applies only to the GitHub source copy.
frozen_evidence.reports_and_attestations: All existing reports, source manifests, protocols, numerical reviews, aggregate snapshots and independent audit attestations retain their original bytes and identities.
frozen_evidence.no_rebinding: No original run binding, evaluation approval or independent-review hash is rewritten to imply that the amended source was the evaluated source.
frozen_evidence.future_local_runs: Any fresh parser run produces the amended source hash and must use newly generated, independently reviewed provenance and bindings. Original exact-source-hash guards remain unchanged and may reject mixed old and amended artifacts.

verification_recipe: Verify the unchanged baseline release manifest against its SHA-256 above.
Verify every file listed by that manifest against its recorded hash, except the single changed file explicitly identified above.
Verify the changed file against its amended SHA-256 above. The only added file is this amendment; its own identity is recorded by the Git commit.
authorization_boundary: This compatibility record does not create or expand data rights, numerical approval, distribution review, or an independent audit attestation.
